Your first class is on us

New students are eligible for one free trial class.

Trial classes must be scheduled 24 hours in advance.

Students should wear comfortable clothing for their trial class.

General policies

Students must check in before entering their class.

Parents must pick up their children on time.

Students should notify the studio if they will be absent.

Missed classes are not automatically refunded.

Food is not allowed inside dance rooms.

Water bottles are allowed inside dance rooms.

Parents may observe classes from the designated viewing area.

Students must follow instructor directions during class.

Students should arrive 10 minutes before their scheduled class.

Beyond the classroom

The studio hosts one annual dance recital.

Recital participation is optional.

Recital costumes are purchased separately.

Students should bring their own water bottles.

The studio offers classes throughout the year.
